buildingBlocks.name: Clock
buildingBlocks.description: Tells the current instant; injected so tests can fix the time.

buildingBlocks.name: Notification
buildingBlocks.description: A message to one user: a subject and a body, as the requesting subsystem wrote them.

buildingBlocks.name: NotificationSender
buildingBlocks.description: Port that delivers a notification to a user.

buildingBlocks.name: NotificationService
buildingBlocks.description: The service the Notifications subsystem offers every other subsystem: takes a request to tell users something and has a notification delivered to each of them.

buildingBlocks.name: NotifyUsers
buildingBlocks.description: Command: a request from another subsystem to tell users something, naming the recipients, a subject and a body. The requesting subsystem chooses the recipients and writes the text.

buildingBlocks.name: Recipient
buildingBlocks.description: A user a notification goes to, by the user's identifier in the identity provider.

buildingBlocks.name: Assignment
buildingBlocks.description: The link between a user, a version and one role the user holds on the version.

buildingBlocks.name: AssignmentRole
buildingBlocks.description: The role a user holds on a version: author, reviewer or approver.

buildingBlocks.name: ContentFile
buildingBlocks.description: A rich-text file the authors write; the body of a QDoc version. Each version has at least one. Its editing, change history and comments belong to the Content management subsystem.

buildingBlocks.name: ContentFileId
buildingBlocks.description: Identity of a content file.

buildingBlocks.name: CreateQDoc
buildingBlocks.description: Command: a quality manager's QDoc creation request, naming the title, the document type, at least one author and, optionally, reviewers and approvers.

buildingBlocks.name: DocumentNumber
buildingBlocks.description: The human-facing identifier a QDoc gets at creation, for searching and for referring to the QDoc. Not a security device.

buildingBlocks.name: DocumentNumberGenerator
buildingBlocks.description: Gives a new QDoc its document number, and owns the rules by which document numbers are composed, sequenced and kept unique. The format, the sequence and the uniqueness are defined by UC-2.

buildingBlocks.name: DocumentType
buildingBlocks.description: The type of a QDoc, one of the list of document types: procedure, guideline, instruction, policy. The list may grow.

buildingBlocks.name: IdentityProvider
buildingBlocks.description: Port to the Identity subsystem, or to a directory the organisation runs: answers which roles a user holds and which users hold the quality manager role.

buildingBlocks.name: NewQDocNotification
buildingBlocks.description: The message telling the quality managers about a new QDoc: names the QDoc, its document number and its creator, and gives the subject and the body the Notifications subsystem is asked to deliver.

buildingBlocks.name: PreparationEventPublisher
buildingBlocks.description: Port that publishes the events of the Preparation subsystem to the other subsystems.

buildingBlocks.name: QDoc
buildingBlocks.description: A quality document: a package of files that always works as a whole. Has a title, a document type, a document number and one or more versions; is either active or archived. Invariants: A QDoc keeps at least one version: every QDoc holds at least one version at all times (FR-PRE-010); no operation leaves a QDoc with zero versions.

buildingBlocks.name: QDocCreated
buildingBlocks.description: Event: a QDoc was created. Published by the Preparation subsystem for any subsystem that follows new QDocs.

buildingBlocks.name: QDocCreationService
buildingBlocks.description: Use cases that create QDocs in the Preparation subsystem.

buildingBlocks.name: QDocId
buildingBlocks.description: Identity of a QDoc inside the QDoc System. Technical identifier, not the document number people use.

buildingBlocks.name: QDocRepository
buildingBlocks.description: Stores and loads QDoc aggregates, whole.

buildingBlocks.name: QDocStatus
buildingBlocks.description: The status of a QDoc itself: active or archived. Workflow statuses belong to versions, not to the QDoc.

buildingBlocks.name: QDocTitle
buildingBlocks.description: The title of a QDoc.

buildingBlocks.name: UserId
buildingBlocks.description: Identity of a user, a person with an account in the identity provider. The Preparation subsystem refers to users only by this identity.

buildingBlocks.name: Version
buildingBlocks.description: A complete, self-contained edition of a QDoc, numbered from 1. Carries the workflow status, the content files and the assignments of people.

buildingBlocks.name: VersionStatus
buildingBlocks.description: The workflow status of a version: new, approved, published, no longer in force or archived.

behaviors.name: send
behaviors.description: Delivers one notification to its recipient.

behaviors.name: notifyUsers
behaviors.description: Tells each user another subsystem names what that subsystem wants them told: one notification per recipient, with the subject and the body of the request. A failed delivery to one recipient stops no other.

behaviors.name: next
behaviors.description: Gives the QDoc being created its document number.

behaviors.name: findQualityManagers
behaviors.description: Lists every user who holds the quality manager role in the organisation at the moment of the call.

behaviors.name: isQualityManager
behaviors.description: Answers whether the user holds the quality manager role at the moment of the call.

behaviors.name: publish
behaviors.description: Publishes a QDocCreated event to the subscribing subsystems.

behaviors.name: create
behaviors.description: Creates an active QDoc from a validated creation request and its document number, together with its first version. Records the QDocCreated event, telling the other subsystems the QDoc exists, for the application service to publish.

behaviors.name: createQDoc
behaviors.description: Creates a QDoc on a quality manager's request: gives it a document number, starts its first version with the people the request names, announces the new QDoc to the other subsystems and has every quality manager told of it.

behaviors.name: createFirst
behaviors.description: Creates the first version of a new QDoc, with the people named at creation assigned to it.

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.notifications.A failed delivery stops no other
rules.name: A failed delivery stops no other
rules.description:
When delivering the notification to one recipient fails, the
notifications to the other recipients are still sent.

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.notifications.Each named recipient receives the notification
rules.name: Each named recipient receives the notification
rules.description:
When a subsystem asks the Notifications subsystem to notify users, each
recipient the request names receives one notification carrying the
subject and the body of the request.

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.A QDoc is saved and announced together
rules.name: A QDoc is saved and announced together
rules.description:
The new QDoc is saved and QDocCreated is published in the same unit of
work: either both happen or neither does. A rejected request creates
nothing and publishes nothing.

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.A QDoc keeps at least one version
rules.name: A QDoc keeps at least one version
rules.description:
Every QDoc holds at least one version at all times (FR-PRE-010); no
operation leaves a QDoc with zero versions.

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.A creation request names a title, a document type and at least one author
rules.name: A creation request names a title, a document type and at least one author
rules.description:
A QDoc creation request that lacks the title, the document type or at
least one author is rejected (FR-PRE-001). Reviewers and approvers are
optional.

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.A document type comes from the list of document types
rules.name: A document type comes from the list of document types
rules.description:
A document type is one of procedure, guideline, instruction and policy
(FR-PRE-002). Adding a type to the list is a change to this list, not to
any QDoc.

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.A new QDoc carries a document number
rules.name: A new QDoc carries a document number
rules.description:
Every QDoc gets its document number when it is created (FR-PRE-009), from
the DocumentNumberGenerator; the format is defined by UC-2.

rules.name: A new QDoc is active
rules.description: A QDoc starts with the status active (FR-PRE-003).

rules.name: A title is never blank
rules.description:
A QDoc title holds at least one character other than whitespace; a blank
title cannot be created.

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.Each quality manager learns of a new QDoc
rules.name: Each quality manager learns of a new QDoc
rules.description:
When a QDoc is created, the Preparation subsystem asks the Notifications
subsystem to notify each quality manager of the organisation, naming the
QDoc, its number and its creator (FR-NOT-001). The quality managers are
those holding the role at the moment the QDoc is created.

rules.name: Only quality managers create QDocs
rules.description:
A QDoc creation request from a user who lacks the quality manager role is
rejected (SR-PRE-001). Authors, reviewers, approvers and auditors create
nothing. The requester's roles are those held at the moment of the
request.

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.The named approvers are assigned to version 1
rules.name: The named approvers are assigned to version 1
rules.description:
Each approver named in the creation request is assigned to version 1 as
approver (FR-PRE-008).

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.The named authors are assigned to version 1
rules.name: The named authors are assigned to version 1
rules.description:
Each author named in the creation request is assigned to version 1 as
author (FR-PRE-006).

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.The named reviewers are assigned to version 1
rules.name: The named reviewers are assigned to version 1
rules.description:
Each reviewer named in the creation request is assigned to version 1 as
reviewer (FR-PRE-007).

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.Version 1 holds one empty content file
rules.name: Version 1 holds one empty content file
rules.description:
Version 1 is created with exactly one content file holding no text, and
no attachment (FR-PRE-005).

rules.id: rule|qdocmanagement.preparation.Version 1 starts with the status new
rules.name: Version 1 starts with the status new
rules.description: Creating a QDoc creates its version 1, with the status new (FR-PRE-004).
